findingClass: A multi-member exchange zip (NSE/BSE offer-document archive) produced a document row for only one of its members: every other non-GID member (a corrigendum, a price-band notice, an addendum) was dropped by the unwrap, so OD-30 precedence can never apply to it (F-154, failure class container-unwrapped-to-one-member).
failThreshold: For every documents row whose url is an exchange .zip and whose zip, re-read by its central directory (HTTP Range request, no full download), holds N PDF members: FAIL when the rows written from that zip (the zip url plus its '#member=<member path>' member urls) number fewer than N minus the GID members minus the members the runner logged as zip_member_skipped (unclassified / too_small / too_large / same_type_as_main), minus the members the runner deduplicated by sha256 (OD-33: the bytes are already stored for this IPO under another url). A central directory carries no sha256, so the durable dedup evidence is another document row of the same IPO with exactly the member's size (measured 2026-09-25: Steamhouse RATIOS_STEAMHOUSE.zip member 'SIL_Price Band Ad_FE.pdf', 2,545,211 bytes, equals the BSE PriceBandAD row), or a zip_member_deduped / zip_member_skipped line for that member in document_fetch_state.last_attempt. The skip dispositions are recomputed from the central directory with the runner's own rules (scripts/lib/zip-member-rows.mjs, parity-tested against the runner source), not read from logs, because last_attempt is overwritten every run. Reported per IPO by name and slug with each missing member's name and position, never as a bare count (signal-ownership.md R1).
unverifiableWhen: The zip URL no longer answers a Range request (the exchange removed or moved it), or the documents row predates the item 22 zip-member change and the runner has not re-fetched that zip since.
note: zip_member_rows: implemented in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs (checkZipMemberRows), pure parts in scripts/lib/zip-member-rows.mjs, tests in scripts/tests/zip-member-rows.test.mjs (imported by scripts/tests/audit-detection-floor.test.mjs so they run in the pr-gate detection-floor step). Network bound: one Range request per zip (two when the directory lies outside the last 64 KB), 15 s per request (ZIP_MEMBER_ROWS_TIMEOUT_MS), 120 s overall (ZIP_MEMBER_ROWS_BUDGET_MS), at most 80 zips (ZIP_MEMBER_ROWS_MAX_ZIPS), newest-examined first; a zip that does not answer a Range request is listed by name as unreadable, never read in full. Known difference from the runner: a member is a PDF here by its .pdf name, there by its %PDF bytes (measured equal on 4 real staging zips, 2026-09-25). The CI unit test scraper/tests/unit/services/zip-member-documents.test.ts still guards the write path itself.
owner: item 22 / item 10 (zip-member rows). First staging run 2026-09-25: see the PR that promoted this check.
